# CodeRabbit findings for PAN-4955 (PR #5032)

CodeRabbit posted 9 inline finding(s). CodeRabbit is advisory: nothing waits for these,
but each one gets an answer, either a fix or a reply with your reason.

- Thread 4469282397 · integrations/grok-build/docs/verification.md:22 [Minor]: Keep the verification token out of stdout.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282397
- Thread 4469282429 · integrations/grok-build/docs/verification.md:25 [Major]: Do not overwrite the existing plugin token.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282429
- Thread 4469282445 · integrations/grok-build/docs/verification.md:29 [Major]: Keep the bearer token out of the process arguments.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282445
- Thread 4469282463 · integrations/grok-build/docs/verification.md:50 [Minor]: Isolate connector state before the local check.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282463
- Thread 4469282478 · integrations/grok-build/docs/verification.md:49 [Minor]: Use the paired-machine count for the connector check.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282478
- Thread 4469282496 · integrations/grok-build/scripts/run-mcp.sh:9 [Major]: Pin the npx fallback to a published release that includes the connector.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282496
- Thread 4469282510 · integrations/shared/SKILL.md:59 [Minor]: Do not infer connector mode from missing `list_machines`.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282510
- Thread 4469282527 · integrations/shared/SKILL.md:59 [Minor]: Do not report a conversation page as the total count.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282527
- Thread 4469282548 · integrations/shared/SKILL.md:63 [Major]: Report unavailable linked-machine results in `/overdeck pending`.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5032#discussion_r4469282548

## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/5032/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-4955`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #5032 has already merged when you read this, nothing more lands on it: open a follow-up issue
   for the findings you agree with instead of pushing.
